scientific_integrity: The unrestricted nine-coordinate feasibility count of 30,240 from prior work already yields the coarse six-coordinate count of 60 by a loop-insertion factor 504; this is explicitly credited. The substantive claim is the sharp minimum-length spectrum 21/22/26/27, orbit-by-orbit description and worst-case 27. The all-length sharp result rests on exact flow balance, five strict interleaving inequalities and Eulerian-circuit realizations. Finite enumeration is an independent cross-check, not the all-length proof.
scientific_limitations: Only circular ternary words, all six off-diagonal cyclic two-gram frequencies positive and pairwise distinct, and no identical adjacent symbols; all-nine-coordinate rankings are excluded. Classification is exact under the stated model, with non-covering literature uncertainty and no external mathematical validation.
title: Sharp realizing-length spectrum for homopolymer-free ternary digram rankings
